facts.fact: On 25 March 2025 the Minister of State Modernisation told a CPLP meeting that the Plano de Ação da Estratégia para a Governação Digital de Cabo Verde (PAEGDCV) 2021-2025 details strategic and structuring measures for the country's digital transformation, including system interoperability and electronic authentication and identification; no cost is stated.
facts.system: Estratégia para a Governação Digital de Cabo Verde / PAEGDCV 2021-2025

facts.fact: The action plan PAEGDCV is stated by the minister on 25 March 2025 to cover 2021-2025, so the date falls inside its stated period; the document does not say whether the text is public.
